tool.name: OGS: MeshMapping
tool.description: Changes the elevation of 2D mesh nodes based on either raster data or another 2D mesh.
tool.command: #if $mesh ln -sf '$mesh' 'mesh.vtu'; #end if #if $raster ln -sf '$raster' 'raster.asc'; #end if ln -sf '$input' 'input.vtu'; MeshMapping $lowpass #if str($static) --static '$static' #end if #if str($distance) --distance '$distance' #end if #if $mesh --mesh 'mesh.vtu' #end if #if $raster --raster 'raster.asc' #end if --input 'input.vtu' --output output_1.vtu

param.label: lowpass
param.help: Applies a lowpass filter to elevation over connected nodes.

param.label: static
param.help: Static elevation to map the input file to. This can be combined with mapping based on rasters or other meshes to deal with locations where no corresponding data exists.

param.label: distance
param.help: Maximum distance to search for mesh nodes if there is no corresponding data for input mesh nodes on the mesh it should be mapped on.

param.label: mesh
param.help: Input (.vtu). 2D mesh file to map the input file on

param.label: raster
param.help: Input (.asc | .grd | .xyz) Raster file to map the input file on

tool.help: Changes the elevation of 2D mesh nodes based on either raster data or another 2D mesh. In addition, a low pass filter can be applied to node elevation based connected nodes.
